    "type": "array",
    "version": "1.0.1",
    "minItems": 1,
    "_uniqueItems": true,
    "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
            "project_igf_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^IGF[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$",

            },
            "name": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^\\w+\\s\\w+\\s?\\w+?$"
